valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: North America heavy-duty truck cycle softens further and pickup demand remains weak, compressing margins

base.driver: Power Systems and data center power generation strength offsets moderate truck/pickup softness, with ~18% EBITDA margin

bull.driver: EPA 2027 pre-buy accelerates heavy-duty truck demand alongside sustained data center power generation growth

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $28.50, the $452.18 close implies 15.9x P/E; the 5 named post-Q3 analyst targets (unweighted average $549.40, undocumented horizon) imply 19.3x at base EPS or $31.39 EPS at 17.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $28.50 (6.3 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Power Systems and Engine segment EBITDA margins and full-year 2027 revenue/margin guidance

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on Nov 5, 2026, all 5 named analysts in the sample (Barclays, Wells Fargo, Truist, Citigroup, JPMorgan) cut their price targets by 11% to 22.5% while maintaining their ratings (4 Buy/Overweight, 1 Neutral). The simple mean of their targets ($549.40) implies +21.5% upside, 11.2 pp above the independent base case (+10.3%), which translates to either ~1.8 turns higher P/E (19.3x vs. 17.5x) or ~$2.89 higher FY2027E EPS ($31.39 vs. $28.50).
